rites.name: Kraggoth
rites.text: Kraggoth is a concept of Oriinnys, a sounding that gathered during the Singing when the first roots of the world began to condense out of resonance. It is less a being than a pressure that shapes how the early tones settle into matter.

rites.name: Ukavanari
rites.text: Ukavanari is the concept of a slow sounding that gathers loose matter into the first roots of Oriinnys, a pull felt by every forming thing. In the Age of Sundering it was the force that tore old bonds apart whenever land broke free from land.

rites.name: Mierys
rites.text: Mierys is the concept of the quiet covenant that binds a sovereign to the groves that feed their kingdom, understood in the Courts as a promise kept between growth and law. It shapes how the first doors between worlds were argued over and sealed during the age of divine trials.

rites.name: Lereostia
rites.text: Lereostia is a concept of Oriinnys, the principle of a threshold held open by sworn orders during the Holy Age. In the Courts it is spoken of as the measure by which divine trials are weighed and the doors between worlds are set.

rites.name: Valiasium
rites.text: Valiasium is a concept of Oriinnys born in the Fall, when the old lattice of worlds gave way and the Sundering scattered its pieces into the Shards. It is remembered as the binding force that held the Pact together, the oath sworn amid broken skies.

rites.name: Ilokanum
rites.text: Ilokanum is a concept in Oriinnys, the principle that a bond holds only while both sides keep their oath, first given form in the Fall of the Ki Realm. In the Age of Sundering it became the reason the Shards would not fully drift apart, since the Pact was sworn in its name.

rites.name: Ilovanira
rites.text: Ilovanira is the concept of walls and the first crossings in Oriinnys, the force that the orders of the Walled Age bound into their stone and ritual. Its presence is felt wherever a boundary is held or a threshold is first passed, and it lends the old churches their endurance.

rites.name: Brarnock
rites.text: Brarnock is the concept of a branching ending within Oriinnys, the moment the Three Futures diverge and the Library must shelve each outcome as its own shelf. It is less a being than a hinge that holds every possible close of the story open at once.
